bestNextCodexPrompt.block: W105: Governed DCC Preview And Operator Approval Model
bestNextCodexPrompt.prompt: Move through W105: Governed DCC Preview And Operator Approval Model. Build the review-only operator approval model that sits between IDB handoff export and any future DCC invocation: operator checklist status, approval evidence fields, type-to-confirm UI placeholder, preview-only Suitelet parameter review, no-submit rollback, and trace coverage. Preserve no IDB writes, no SuiteScript invocation from IDB, no transaction writes, hosted resolver optional until remoteSmokeExecuted=true, notes story-only, consultant confirmation required, W92 state authority, and DCC ownership of item names, assemblies, BOMs, locations, planning, routing/WIP, CSV, and Sales Order mechanics. Output approval model contract, Review UI summary, trace samples, validator gates, W105 report, and best next Codex prompt.
